interventions.match_knot_unit_step: Set u=(t-t_left)/h at the frozen match cell, build the same natural cubic spline in u, and convert its first and second derivatives to physical time by 1/h and 1/h squared.
interventions.match_knot_ordinate_center: Subtract the combined-ordinate vector at the frozen left match knot before constructing the natural cubic spline; restore it only to the interpolated value. First and second derivatives are unchanged mathematically.

interpretation: This tests algebraically equivalent changes in the amplitude full-series natural spline on one frozen NQC chart, with unchanged phase fit, NQC targets, and 3x3 solve. A pass requires eager preservation and both original eager/JIT gates. Failure stays visible; this does not establish source fidelity or release qualification.
